00044 #define PtrUGenProcessBlock()                                                       \
00045     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();                            \
00046     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();                              \
00047     float nextValue = (float)*ptr;                                                  \
00048     memset(outputSamples, 0, numSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));                  \
00049     if(nextValue == value_) {                                                       \
00050         for(int i = 0; i < numSamplesToProcess; ++i)                                \
00051             outputSamples[i] += nextValue;                                          \
00052     } else {                                                                        \
00053         int numKrSamplesToProcess = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();                \
00054         float valueSlope = (nextValue - value_) * UGen::getControlSlopeFactor();    \
00055         numSamplesToProcess -= numKrSamplesToProcess;                               \
00056         for(int i = 0; i < numKrSamplesToProcess; ++i) {                            \
00057             *outputSamples++ += value_;                                             \
00058             value_ += valueSlope;                                                   \
00059         }                                                                           \
00060         if(numSamplesToProcess > 0) {                                               \
00061             for(int i = 0; i < numSamplesToProcess; ++i)                            \
00062                 outputSamples[i] += nextValue;                                      \
00063         }                                                                           \
00064         value_ = nextValue;                                                         \
00065     }
